subject: Next steps: procurement path, SOC 2 / DPA timeline, and onboarding asks
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement path, SOC 2 / DPA timeline, and onboarding asks

Thanks again for your time earlier, Asha and Tom — good call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the pilot procurement and compliance items.

Recap (what we heard)
- Pilot: 3-month evaluation, 1–2 models, ~10k tokens/day average, occasional peak loads for batch imports.
- Primary constraint: Nimbus procurement requires either a PO + net30 invoice flow OR purchasing via Azure Marketplace (preferred by finance for centralized billing).
- Security/compliance gating: SOC 2 report and an accepted DPA; procurement team will push the security questionnaire (bit more detailed).

Proposed path / asks
1) Procurement route: please confirm whether procurement would accept a PO + Redwood invoice (monthly) or whether they require Marketplace only. If Marketplace, who is the contact at your cloud ops team?
2) Security artifacts: attaching our most recent SOC 2 (2026) and our standard DPA template. We can sign Nimbus redlines; please highlight any non-standard clauses.
3) Security questionnaire: when does your security team plan to send the questionnaire? Typical turnaround we see is 3–5 business days for the initial review. If you prefer, we can pre-fill sections that are stable (data handling, retention, encryption).
4) Onboarding timeline: assuming PO cleared in 2 weeks and questionnaire completes in 5 business days, we can target pilot kickoff the week of Oct 4. Ben will scope cloud onboarding and account provisioning.

Next steps (who does what)
- Asha: confirm procurement preference (PO vs Marketplace) and share procurement contact / email.
- Tom: flag expected security questionnaire send date and any pre-filled sections you want from us.
- Marissa: (cc) I aligned pricing ranges in the attached spreadsheet; can you confirm the pilot seat counts & expected token volumes?
- Ben: will prepare a short SOW for the pilot and an ops checklist for Marketplace onboarding if needed.

Attachments: SOC2-report-2026.pdf (stub); Redwood-DPA-template.docx (stub); Procurement-options-table.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-week if I haven’t heard back.

—
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path, SOC 2 / DPA timeline, and onboarding asks

Hi Chloe — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers inline and some clarifying questions.

Procurement route
- Nimbus prefers PO + invoice for direct contracts, but finance has been pushing Marketplace for smaller vendors. For a multi-month pilot with expected spend > $10k/mo we can do a PO (good). I looped in procurement@nimbushealth.com here (they can confirm the PO flow).

Security artifacts
- SOC 2 looks good at a glance. We will need the DPA redline — procurement will run legal review. If you can provide a short summary page (one-pager) that highlights data residency (US-only), retention defaults, and subprocessor list that would speed legal.

Security questionnaire
- We plan to send the standard vendor security questionnaire tomorrow (Sep 16). There are a few items around key management and audit logs where we may ask for additional detail (HSM/KMS options, retention of request logs). Pre-fill is helpful — appreciate that offer.

Marketplace vs PO follow-up
- Procurement: procurement@nimbushealth.com will confirm the formal PO steps and expected lead time (likely 7–10 business days once they have the PO request). If Redwood can provide a billing contact with invoices issued to Nimbus Health (legal entity), that will help.

Onboarding timing
- If questionnaire goes out Sep 16 and returns Sep 21, and procurement issues PO by Sep 29, Oct 4 kickoff is reasonable.

One small ask: we are sensitive to PHI scope during the pilot. Can you confirm whether any test datasets will include PHI and how Redwood recommends isolating that work (VPC/private deployment vs hosted with strict retentions)?

I’ll loop procurement once they confirm the PO path.

—
Asha Patel
Head of Data Partnerships | Nimbus Health
asha.patel@nimbushealth.com | +1 (202) 555-9321
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path, SOC 2 / DPA timeline, and onboarding asks

Thanks, Asha — great, that aligns with our expectations. Quick responses and actions from our side: 

1) PHI / data handling
- Pilot recommendation: if you will process PHI we strongly recommend Redwood Private (VPC) for isolation. Hosted API can be configured with strict retention and field-level redaction, but for regulated PHI workloads the VPC package is the safer option. I’ve added a short summary below:
  - Redwood Private (recommended): customer-managed VPC, optional on-prem package, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs retained per your retention policy.
  - Hosted with restrictions: we can set token-level retention to 0/30/90 days and disable logging of request bodies, but this is not a substitute for VPC when PHI is in-scope.

2) One-pager for legal
- Attached and added the subprocessor list & retention summary to the drive link. We can also produce a short DPA redline summary that calls out our standard exceptions.

3) Security questionnaire and KMS details
- Ben will own the KMS/HSM and logs response. Ben — can you prepare the KMS options note and an audit-logs snapshot that we can drop into Nimbus’ questionnaire? I’ll pre-fill the general controls sections (ISO/SOC items).

4) Procurement / billing contacts
- Procurement: procurement@nimbushealth.com (cc) — can you confirm the legal entity name for the PO and the billing email for invoices? If Marketplace becomes necessary we’ll provide the onboarding checklist but prefer PO for predictability.

I’ll follow up with the one-pager and the DPA redline summary by EOB today.

—
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path, SOC 2 / DPA timeline, and onboarding asks

Hi Asha / Chloe — looping in a brief technical note for the questionnaire and PHI callouts.

KMS / encryption
- We support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and bring-your-own HSM for Private deployments. For hosted customers we offer envelope encryption with keys we rotate; audit logs are available for 90 days by default and can be extended. If Nimbus requires HSM-backed keys we can enable a BYOK flow — that would be part of the Private package.

Audit logs / retention
- Request/response logs: can be disabled for hosted or routed to your log sink in Private.
- KV cache / inference traces: stored for 7 days by default; we can extend retention and provide export.

Quick onboarding checklist (pilot PO route)
- PO issued to: "Nimbus Health, Inc." (confirm)
- SOW signed (we’ll send a short SOW + statement of work for pilot)
- Account provisioning: we’ll provision a sandbox with 2 seats and one model snapshot (Ben to confirm exact instance size after Marissa confirms volumes)
- DPA execution: legal to confirm redlines; we can accept 2–3 minor redlines without escalation

If procurement prefers Marketplace instead, we will share the Marketplace onboarding checklist and estimate the 1–2 day difference to start (billing and account mapping work).

Happy to jump on a short call with your security team when questionnaire lands — say 30 minutes to walk the KMS/logs/PHI options.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
